Added the checkbox 'Send a message when the captures of a source fail' on the messages settings page (value stored as source_alert_on, default on). With 0, source_alert_messages() gives no message. Tests in tests/test_source_alert_setting.py. First CI run failed on a settings test (a label without for=); fixed in a second commit. Shipped as PR #1191 (merged). Next: #1173, the caller that sends the messages after each ingest.
